		public static void GetPureDatabanks(ref ArrayList listDatabanks)
		{
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0098: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<int> source = (from IDatabank db in listDatabanks
				where db != null && ApPureDatabankNames.Contains(db.Name)
				select Convert.ToInt32(db.Name.Substring(4, 2))).ToList();
			if (!source.Any())
			{
				return;
			}
			string strB = "PURE" + source.Max();
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			foreach (IDatabank listDatabank in listDatabanks)
			{
				IDatabank val = listDatabank;
				if (val != null && ApPureDatabankNames.Contains(val.Name))
				{
					if (string.CompareOrdinal(val.Name, strB) == 0)
					{
						arrayList.Add(val);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					arrayList.Add(val);
				}
			}
			listDatabanks.Clear();
			listDatabanks = arrayList;
		}

		public static void GetComponentAttrs(ICollection ivCollection, out Dictionary<string, string> dictAttrIdValues)
		{
			dictAttrIdValues = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			if (ivCollection == null || ivCollection.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IIdentifierValue item in ivCollection.OfType<IIdentifierValue>().ToList())
			{
				string[] array = (string[])item.ValueList;
				IIdentifier identifier = item.Identifier;
				dictAttrIdValues[identifier.Name] = array[0];
			}
		}

		public static void GetComponentPropertyValueAttrs(ICollection pvCollection, out Dictionary<string, object> dictPropertyNameValues)
		{
			dictPropertyNameValues = new Dictionary<string, object>();
			if (pvCollection == null || pvCollection.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IPropertyValue item in pvCollection.OfType<IPropertyValue>().ToList())
			{
				dictPropertyNameValues[item.Property.Name] = item.Value;
			}
		}

		private static void SetDatabankToDatabase(IList myDatabases, IDatabase dbase, IDictionary dbDataBankList, IDatabank dbBank)
		{
			if (!myDatabases.Contains(dbase))
			{
				myDatabases.Add(dbase);
				ArrayList value = new ArrayList { dbBank };
				dbDataBankList.Add(dbase, value);
			}
			else
			{
				((ArrayList)dbDataBankList[dbase]).Add(dbBank);
			}
		}

		private static void SelectDatabanks(ICollection dBankList, IDatabaseCollection dbList, IList myDatabases, IDictionary dbDataBankList)
		{
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0065: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IDatabankCollection source = default(IDatabankCollection);
			foreach (string dBank in dBankList)
			{
				int num = dBank.IndexOf(' ');
				string strB = dBank.Substring(0, num);
				string dbankName = dBank.Substring(num + 1, dBank.Length - num - 1);
				IDatabank val = null;
				foreach (IDatabase item in (IEnumerable)dbList)
				{
					IDatabase val2 = item;
					if (string.CompareOrdinal(val2.Alias, strB) == 0)
					{
						val2.EnumerateDatabanks(ref source);
						val = (from IDatabank databank in (IEnumerable)source
							where string.CompareOrdinal(databank.Name, dbankName) == 0
							select databank).FirstOrDefault();
						SetDatabankToDatabase(myDatabases, val2, dbDataBankList, val);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static double ProcessMatchCollection(ICollection matches, string propName, out string dbName, out string dbankName, out string compIndex, out string compName, out string compAlias, out string casNumber)
		{

			double result = 1E+35;

			dbankName = "";
			compIndex = "";
			compName = "";
			compAlias = "";
			casNumber = "";

			{
				object obj = ((match is FoundCompounds) ? match : null);
				_ = ((FoundCompounds)obj).Compound.Compound1Name;
				IDatabank databank = ((FoundCompounds)obj).Databank;
				if (databank != null)
				{
					dbName = databank.Database.Alias;
					dbankName = databank.Name;
				}
				ICollection identifierValues = ((FoundCompounds)obj).IdentifierValues;
				ICollection propertyValues = ((FoundCompounds)obj).PropertyValues;
				if (identifierValues != null && identifierValues.Count > 0)
				{
					Array array = Array.CreateInstance(typeof(IIdentifierValue), identifierValues.Count);
					identifierValues.CopyTo(array, 0);
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						IIdentifierValue val = (IIdentifierValue)array.GetValue(i);
						if (val != null)
						{
							string[] array2 = (string[])val.ValueList;
							switch (val.Identifier.Name)
							{
							case "CompoundIndex":
								compIndex = array2[0];
								break;
							case "NAME":
								compName = array2[0];
								break;
							case "ALIAS":
								compAlias = array2[0];
								break;
							case "CASRN":
								casNumber = array2[0];
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (propertyValues == null || propertyValues.Count <= 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Array array3 = Array.CreateInstance(typeof(IPropertyValue), propertyValues.Count);
				propertyValues.CopyTo(array3, 0);
				for (int j = 0; j < array3.Length; j++)
				{
					IPropertyValue val2 = (IPropertyValue)array3.GetValue(j);
					if (val2 != null && val2 != null && val2.Value != null && val2.Property.Name.ToLower() == propName.ToLower())
					{
						result = Convert.ToDouble(val2.Value);
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		private void CheckDescriptor(string descriptor)
		{
			if (descriptor.Length > 32)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The descriptor length exceeds the maximum length of 32 chars: " + descriptor);
			}
		}

		public int CompareTo(IComponent other)
		{
			if (Index < other.Index)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (Index == other.Index)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public bool Equals(IComponent other)

				return false;

				return true;
			}

			{
				return false;
			}
			return UserSuppliedName.Equals(other.UserSuppliedName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()

		public bool TryGetComponent(in string genericSearch, out IComponent component)
		{
			component = null;
			if (UserSuppliedNames.Contains(genericSearch))
			{
				int index = UserSuppliedNames.IndexOf(genericSearch);
				component = ((IList<IComponent>)Components)[index];
				return true;
			}
			if (int.TryParse(genericSearch, out var result) && 0 < result && result <= Count)
			{
				component = ((IList<IComponent>)Components)[result - 1];
				return true;
			}
			foreach (IComponent item in (IEnumerable<IComponent>)Components)
			{
				if (string.Equals(genericSearch, item.Descriptor, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					component = item;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateComponents()
		{
			Indexes = new List<int>();
			UserSuppliedNames = new List<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ICollection<IComponent>)Components).Count; i++)
			{
				Component component = (Component)(object)((IList<IComponent>)Components)[i];
				component.Index = i + 1;
				if (!Parent.FortranClient && component.UserSuppliedName.Length > 8)
				{
					component.EngineId = "IDX-" + component.Index;
				}
				else
				{
					component.UserSuppliedName = component.UserSuppliedName.ToUpper();
					component.Descriptor = component.Descriptor.ToUpper();
					component.EngineId = component.Descriptor;
				}
				Indexes.Add(component.Index);
				UserSuppliedNames.Add(component.UserSuppliedName);
			}
			List<IComponent> list = new List<IComponent>();
			foreach (IComponent item in (IEnumerable<IComponent>)Components)
			{
				if (item.Ids.Alias == null)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			new OptimizedComponentQuery((IEnumerable<IDataSource>)Parent.ParameterManager.DataSources, (IEnumerable<IComponent>)Components, DBConfiguration).Search(out var componentIdsByAlias);
			foreach (IComponent item2 in list)
			{
				if (componentIdsByAlias.TryGetValue(item2.Descriptor, out var value))
				{
					ComponentIds componentIds = (ComponentIds)(object)item2.Ids;
					componentIds.Alias = value.Alias;
					if (value.CASRN != null)
					{
						componentIds.CASRN = value.CASRN;
					}
					if (value.Name == null)
					{
						componentIds.Name = componentIds.Alias;
					}
					else
					{
						componentIds.Name = value.Name;
					}
					if (value.ClassId < 1E+35)
					{
						componentIds.ClassId = (int)value.ClassId;
					}
					if (value.HYSYSId < 1E+35)
					{
						componentIds.HYSYSId = (int)value.HYSYSId;
					}
					if (value.EDLId < 1E+35)
					{
						componentIds.EDLId = (int)value.EDLId;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckComponents()
		{
			if (Count <= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Components are missing.");
			}
			var list = (from x in (IEnumerable<IComponent>)Components
				group x by x into y
				where y.Count() > 1
				select new
				{
					Component = y.Key,
					Counter = y.Count()
				}).ToList();
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = "User supplied name must be unique.\n";
			foreach (var item in list)
			{
				text += $"\nComponent {item.Component.UserSuppliedName} occurs ({item.Counter}) times.";
			}
			throw new ArgumentException(text);
		}

		}

	public abstract class LazyFactory<TKey, TValue> : ILazyFactory<TKey, TValue>
	{
		protected delegate TValue Instantiater();

		private readonly Dictionary<TKey, TValue> _instancedObjects = new Dictionary<TKey, TValue>();

		private readonly object _lockingObject = new object();

		protected readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<TKey, Instantiater> Instantiaters;

		public IEnumerable<TKey> ValidKeys => Instantiaters.Keys;

		protected LazyFactory(IReadOnlyDictionary<TKey, Instantiater> instantiaters)
		{
			Instantiaters = instantiaters;
		}

		public TValue GetOrCreate(TKey key)
		{
			lock (_lockingObject)
			{
				if (_instancedObjects.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				if (!Instantiaters.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					return value;
				}
				_instancedObjects.Add(key, Instantiaters[key]());
				return _instancedObjects[key];
			}
		}

		public bool IsInstantited(TKey key)
		{
			return _instancedObjects.ContainsKey(key);
		}
	}

	internal class ObservableList<T> : IObservableListExt<T>, IObservableList<T>, IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable, INotifyCollectionChanged
	{
		protected List<T> _list = new List<T>();

		private ILazyFactory<string, T> _factory;

		public bool AllowDuplicates { get; private set; }

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return _list[index];
			}
			set
			{
				CheckIndex(index);
				if ((_list[index] != null || value != null) && !_list[index].Equals(value) && (AllowDuplicates || !Contains(value)))
				{
					T val = _list[index];
					_list[index] = value;
					OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace, value, val));
				}
			}
		}

		public int Count => _list.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		public ObservableList()
			: this((IEnumerable<T>)null, (ILazyFactory<string, T>)null, allowDuplicates: true)
		{
		}

		public ObservableList(bool allowDuplicates)
			: this((IEnumerable<T>)null, (ILazyFactory<string, T>)null, allowDuplicates)

		}

			: this((IEnumerable<T>)null, objectFactory, allowDuplicates: true)
		{
		}

			: this((IEnumerable<T>)null, objectFactory, allowDuplicates)
		{
		}

		public ObservableList(IEnumerable<T> list, ILazyFactory<string, T> objectFactory)
			: this(list, objectFactory, allowDuplicates: true)
		{
		}

		public ObservableList(IEnumerable<T> list, ILazyFactory<string, T> objectFactory, bool allowDuplicates)
		{
			if (list != null)
			{
				_list = new List<T>(list);
			}
			_factory = objectFactory;
			AllowDuplicates = allowDuplicates;
		}

		private void CheckIndex(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
			{
				throw new IndexOutOfRangeException($"The specified index ({index}) is out of range " + $"(where Count = {Count}).");
			}
		}

		private void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			this.CollectionChanged?.Invoke(this, args);
		}

		public void Add(T item)
		{
			if (AllowDuplicates || !Contains(item))
			{
				_list.Add(item);
				OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, item));
			}
		}

		public T AddByName(string name)
		{
			T factoryItem = GetFactoryItem(name);
			Add(factoryItem);
			return factoryItem;
		}

		public void AddByName(IEnumerable<string> items)
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			if (AllowDuplicates)
			{
				foreach (string item in items)
				{
					T factoryItem = GetFactoryItem(item);
					list.Add(factoryItem);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (string item2 in items)
				{
					T factoryItem2 = GetFactoryItem(item2);
					if (!Contains(factoryItem2))
					{
						list.Add(factoryItem2);
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count != 0)
			{
				AddRange(list);
			}
		}

		private T GetFactoryItem(string name)
		{
			if (_factory == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("This object does not include a factory to add by name.");
			}
			try
			{
				return ((ILazyFactory<string, string>)(object)_factory).GetOrCreate(name);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Bad name " + name.ToUpper() + ".");
			}
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<T> items)
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			if (AllowDuplicates)
			{
				list.AddRange(items);
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (T item in items)
				{
					if (!Contains(item) && !list.Contains(item))
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count != 0)
			{
				_list.AddRange(list);
				OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, items));
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_list.Clear();
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			return _list.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			_list.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public int IndexOf(T item)
		{
			return _list.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			CheckIndex(index);
			_list.Insert(index, item);
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, item, index));
		}

		public bool Remove(T item)
		{
			if (_list.Remove(item))
			{
				OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, item));
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			CheckIndex(index);
			T val = _list[index];
			_list.RemoveAt(index);
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove, val, index));
		}

		public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _list.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}

		public IList<int> GetNBOPST()
		{
			if (GlobalOptionSet == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("Global option set not defined.");
			}
			if (FreeWaterMethod == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("Free-water method not defined.");
			}

		}

		public IList<int> GetNBOPST(string mainOptionSetName, string freeWaterMethodName)
		{
			mainOptionSetName = mainOptionSetName.ToUpper();
			freeWaterMethodName = freeWaterMethodName.ToUpper();
			bool flag = this[mainOptionSetName] != null;
			bool flag2 = this[freeWaterMethodName] != null;
			if (flag && flag2)
			{
				return GetNBOPST(this[mainOptionSetName], this[freeWaterMethodName]);
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (!flag)
			{
				text = "Unknown main option set: " + mainOptionSetName.ToUpper();
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				string text2 = (flag ? "" : "\n");
				text = text + text2 + "Unknown free water method: " + freeWaterMethodName.ToUpper();
			}
			throw new ArgumentException(text);
		}

		public IList<int> GetNBOPST(IOptionSet mainOptionSet, IOptionSet freeWaterMethod)
		{
			//IL_0097: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_00e4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
				if (!Contains(item))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Invalid option set " + item.DisplayName + ".");
				}
			}
			if (!freeWaterMethod.IsValidFreeWaterMethod)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Method " + freeWaterMethod.DisplayName + " is not a valid free-water method.");
			}
			try
			{
				List<int> list = new List<int>(new int[6]);

				list[0] = ((BeadId)(ref id)).RawNumber;

				list[3] = GlobalOpSets[3];
				id = ((IGenerateBeadData)freeWaterMethod).BeadData.Id;
				list[4] = ((BeadId)(ref id)).RawNumber;

		public IDictionary<string, IApedParameterResult> Search(IList<IDataSource> dataSourceList = null, IList<IComponent> componentList = null, IList<IOptionSet> optionSetList = null)
		{
			Console.WriteLine("Searching for Parameters in:");
			if (dataSourceList == null)
			{
				dataSourceList = (IList<IDataSource>)Parent.ParameterManager.DataSources;
				Console.WriteLine("    All Data Sources");
			}
			if (componentList == null)
			{
				componentList = (IList<IComponent>)Parent.ComponentManager.Components;
				Console.WriteLine("    All Components");
			}
			if (optionSetList == null)
			{
				optionSetList = (IList<IOptionSet>)Parent.OptionSetManager.OptionSets;
				Console.WriteLine("    All OptionSets");
			}
			List<string> list = Parent.OptionSetManager.GenerateGlobalDefaultParameterList();
			foreach (OptionSet optionSet in optionSetList)
			{
				list.AddRange(optionSet.GenerateParameterList());
			}
			List<string> list2 = list.Distinct().ToList();
			List<IPropertyParameter> list3 = new List<IPropertyParameter>();
			ILazyFactory<string, IPropertyParameter> propertyParameter = Factories.PropertyParameter;
			foreach (string item2 in list2)
			{
				PropertyParameter item = (PropertyParameter)(object)propertyParameter.GetOrCreate(item2);
				list3.Add((IPropertyParameter)(object)item);
			}

			return searchResultByName;
		}

		public StringBuilder OutputToAspenPlus(IDictionary<string, IApedParameterResult> searchResults)
		{
			Dictionary<string, List<string>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();
			foreach (IApedParameterResult value2 in searchResults.Values)
			{
				if (dictionary.TryGetValue(value2.ParameterName, out var value))
				{
					value.Add(value2.ToAspenPlusInput());
					continue;
				}
				dictionary.Add(value2.ParameterName, new List<string> { value2.ToAspenPlusInput() });
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, List<string>> item in dictionary)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("PROP-DATA" + Environment.NewLine);
				stringBuilder.Append(Indent() + "IN-UNITS SI SHORT-LENGTH=mm" + Environment.NewLine);
				stringBuilder.Append(Indent() + "PROP-LIST " + item.Key + Environment.NewLine);
				foreach (string item2 in item.Value)
				{
					string[] array = item2.Split(new string[1] { Environment.NewLine }, StringSplitOptions.None);
					foreach (string myString in array)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(Indent(3) + SplitStringForInput(myString, 72, 8) + Environment.NewLine);
					}
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(Environment.NewLine);
			}
			return stringBuilder;
		}

		private string SplitStringForInput(string myString, int maxColumnLength = 72, int paragraphIndentLength = 4)
		{
			string[] array = myString.Split(' ');
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int num = 0;
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text in array2)
			{
				if (num + text.Length + 1 < maxColumnLength - paragraphIndentLength)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat(" {0}", text);
					num = stringBuilder.Length % (maxColumnLength - paragraphIndentLength);
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat(" &");
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}{1}", Environment.NewLine + Indent(paragraphIndentLength), text);
					num = paragraphIndentLength + text.Length;
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private string Indent(int indentLength = 4)
		{
			return new string(' ', indentLength);
		}

		private void CreateChargeLists(IObservableList<IComponent> ComponentManagerList)
		{
			_ = ((ICollection<IComponent>)ComponentManagerList).Count;
			if (compType != null)
			{
				compType.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				compType = new List<int>();
			}
			if (neutralIndexList != null)
			{
				neutralIndexList.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				neutralIndexList = new List<double>();
			}
			if (cationIndexList != null)
			{
				cationIndexList.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				cationIndexList = new List<double>();
			}
			if (anionIndexList != null)
			{
				anionIndexList.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				anionIndexList = new List<double>();
			}
			neutralCount = 0;
			anionCount = 0;
			cationCount = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ICollection<IComponent>)ComponentManagerList).Count; i++)
			{
				IComponent component = ((IList<IComponent>)ComponentManagerList)[i];
				double num = GetParameterValue("CHARGE", component)[0];
				if (num == 0.0 || num == 1E+35)
				{
					neutralCount++;
					compType.Add(0);
					neutralIndexList.Add(neutralCount);
					cationIndexList.Add(0.0);
					anionIndexList.Add(0.0);
				}
				else if (num > 0.0)
				{
					cationCount++;
					compType.Add(1);
					cationIndexList.Add(cationCount);
					neutralIndexList.Add(0.0);
					anionIndexList.Add(0.0);
				}
				else if (num < 0.0)
				{
					anionCount++;
					compType.Add(-1);
					anionIndexList.Add(anionCount);
					cationIndexList.Add(0.0);
					neutralIndexList.Add(0.0);
				}
			}
			SetChargeCount(neutralCount, anionCount, cationCount);
		}

		private IList<int> SetChargeCount(int neutralCount, int anionCount, int cationCount)
		{
			if (NM_NA_NCAT == null)
			{
				NM_NA_NCAT = new List<int> { neutralCount, anionCount, cationCount };
			}
			else
			{
				NM_NA_NCAT[0] = neutralCount;
				NM_NA_NCAT[1] = anionCount;
				NM_NA_NCAT[2] = cationCount;
			}
			return NM_NA_NCAT;
		}

		private void FillParameterDefault(IPropertyParameter parameter, Dictionary<string, int> parameterOffsets, int noOfComponents, ref IBeadRealData NBD)
		{
			int offset = parameterOffsets[parameter.Name];
			PropertyParameter propertyParameter = (PropertyParameter)(object)parameter;
			if (propertyParameter.IsUnary())
			{
				FillPure(noOfComponents, propertyParameter.Elements, ref NBD, offset);
			}
			else if (propertyParameter.IsBinary())
			{
				FillBinary(noOfComponents, propertyParameter.Elements, ref NBD, offset);
			}
			else if (!propertyParameter.IsPair())
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException("Dimension code not handled.");
			}
		}

		private void FillPure(int noOfComponents, IList<IPropertyParameterElement> propertyParameterElements, ref IBeadRealData NBD, int offset)
		{

					NBD[offset + num] = (flag ? 1E+35 : propertyParameterElements[j].Default);
				}
			}
		}

		private void FillBinary(int noOfComponents, IList<IPropertyParameterElement> propertyParameterElements, ref IBeadRealData NBD, int offset)

		private PropertyParameter RetrivePropertyParameter(in string parameterName, out int offset)
		{
			TryGenerateBeads();
			if (NBD == null)
			{
				throw new NullReferenceException("Parameter data bead (NBD) is null.");
			}
			if (ParameterOffsetByName.TryGetValue(parameterName, out offset))
			{
				return (PropertyParameter)(object)Factories.PropertyParameter.GetOrCreate(parameterName);
			}
			if (parameterName != parameterName.ToUpper())
			{
				return RetrivePropertyParameter(parameterName.ToUpper(), out offset);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("Unknown parameter " + parameterName + ".");
		}

		public BeadId GenerateBeads(IBeadFile beadFile)
		{
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0088: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0107: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0137: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_013d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0159: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0175: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0192: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int num = 3 + _methodCodes.Count + _methodCodes.Sum((IMethodCode s) => 2 + 4 * s.Steps.Count());
			_bead = beadFile.CreateBead(num, 0);
			_bead[0] = WordUtility.FirstWord(_name);
			_bead[1] = WordUtility.SecondWord(_name);
			_bead[2] = RawInteger.op_Implicit((long)_methodCodes.Count);
			int num2 = 3;
			int num3 = num2 + _methodCodes.Count;
			foreach (IMethodCode methodCode in _methodCodes)
			{
				_bead[num2++] = RawInteger.op_Implicit((long)num3);
				_bead[num3++] = RawInteger.op_Implicit((long)methodCode.GoToIndex);
				_bead[num3++] = RawInteger.op_Implicit((long)methodCode.Steps.Count);
				foreach (IPropertyMethodStep step in methodCode.Steps)
				{
					_bead[num3++] = RawInteger.op_Implicit((long)step.PropertyType);
					_bead[num3++] = WordUtility.FirstWord(step.PropertyName);
					_bead[num3++] = WordUtility.SecondWord(step.PropertyName);
					_bead[num3++] = RawInteger.op_Implicit((long)step.StepCode);
				}
			}
			return _bead.Id;
		}

		internal static IPropertyParameterElement Copy(IPropertyParameterElement element, double? _default = null, double? lowerLimit = null, double? upperLimit = null, double? nominalValue = null, string label = null, string label2 = null, bool? useFormula = null, int? formulaIndex = null, PhysicalQuantities? physicalQuantity = null, RegressionCode? regressionOption = null, double? deltaT = null, int? numPoints = null, SymmetryCode? symmetry = null)
		{
			//IL_0103: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0125: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0189: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0180: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return (IPropertyParameterElement)(object)new PropertyParameterElement
			{
				Default = (_default ?? element.Default),
				LowerLimit = (lowerLimit ?? element.LowerLimit),
				UpperLimit = (upperLimit ?? element.UpperLimit),
				NominalValue = (nominalValue ?? element.NominalValue),
				Label = (label ?? element.Label),
				Label2 = (label2 ?? element.Label2),
				UseFormula = (useFormula ?? element.UseFormula),
				FormulaIndex = (formulaIndex ?? element.FormulaIndex),
				PhysicalQuantity = (PhysicalQuantities)(((??)physicalQuantity) ?? element.PhysicalQuantity),
				RegressionCode = (RegressionCode)(((??)regressionOption) ?? element.RegressionCode),
				DeltaT = (deltaT ?? element.DeltaT),
				NPoints = (numPoints ?? element.NPoints),
				SymmetryCode = (SymmetryCode)(((??)symmetry) ?? element.SymmetryCode)
			};
		}
	}
	internal class PropertyRouteInfo : IPropertyRouteInfo, IEquatable<IPropertyRouteInfo>
	{
		public string Keyword { get; set; }

		public string RouteId { get; set; }

		public bool Equals(IPropertyRouteInfo other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((object)this == other)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (GetType() != ((object)other).GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Keyword != other.Keyword)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (RouteId != other.RouteId)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Keyword.GetHashCode() ^ RouteId.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

		{
			double result = 0.0;

			{
			case 1:
				result = parameterValue[0] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col);
				break;
			case 2:
				result = parameterValue[2] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = parameterValue[3] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col) * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 2:
				result = parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col) * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col), 2.0)));
				break;
			case 3:
				result = parameterValue[3] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col), 2.0);
				break;
			case 4:
				result = parameterValue[4] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col), 2.0);
				break;
			case 5:
				result = parameterValue[5] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col) * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col), 3.0));
				break;
			case 6:
				result = parameterValue[6] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col), 3.0);
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[7] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col) * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col), 3.0)));
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[8] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col) * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col), 2.0)));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = parameterValue[9] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col) * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col), 3.0)));
				break;
			case 10:
				result = parameterValue[10] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col) * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 4.0) * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col), 2.0)));
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)15, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col))) * (double)(valueNotExists[3] * (valueNotExists[4] * valueNotExists[5])) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)15, col) * (parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) - 2.0 * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[3] * (valueNotExists[4] * valueNotExists[5])));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)15, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 6:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)15, col) * (parameterValue[3] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)15, col) * (parameterValue[4] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 8:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)15, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 0.5));
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 10:
				result = parameterValue[6] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 0.5) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			case 11:
				result = parameterValue[7] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 10:
				result = parameterValue[6] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 0.5) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			case 11:
				result = parameterValue[7] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * (parameterValue[0] - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0)) + parameterValue[4] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 4.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 4.0)) - parameterValue[5] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 5.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 5.0)) + parameterValue[6] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 6.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 6.0)) - parameterValue[7] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 7.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 7.0)) + parameterValue[8] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 8.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 8.0)) - parameterValue[9] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 9.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 9.0)));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * (parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0))) + 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 4.0 * (parameterValue[4] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 4.0))) + 5.0 * (parameterValue[5] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 4.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 5.0))) - 6.0 * (parameterValue[6] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 5.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 6.0))) + 7.0 * (parameterValue[7] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 6.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 7.0))) - 8.0 * (parameterValue[8] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 7.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 8.0))) + 9.0 * (parameterValue[9] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 8.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 9.0))));

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)37, col) * (parameterValue[0] - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0)));
				break;
			case 3:

		{
			double result = 0.0;

				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));

		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)

				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 10:
				result = parameterValue[6] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 0.5) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col);
				break;
			case 11:
				result = parameterValue[7] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 10:
				result = parameterValue[6] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 0.5) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col);
				break;
			case 11:
				result = parameterValue[7] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)4, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

			case 1:

				_ = valueNotExists[2];

				result = num2 - 0.0;
				break;
			}
			case 2:
			{
				double num = parameterValue[4] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				_ = valueNotExists[2];
				_ = valueNotExists[4];
				result = num - 0.0;
				break;
			}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = parameterValue[0] - Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col)) * -5.0 * 0.43429448 - parameterValue[2] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * (double)(valueNotExists[1] * valueNotExists[2]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = parameterValue[1] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			case 4:
				result = parameterValue[3] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
			{
				double num = parameterValue[0] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				_ = valueNotExists[0];
				_ = valueNotExists[2];
				result = num - 0.0;
				break;
			}
			case 2:
				result = parameterValue[1] - parameterValue[2] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = ((parameterValue[2] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - parameterValue[1] * UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) - parameterValue[3] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0)) * (double)valueNotExists[4] + parameterValue[0]) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) * (double)valueNotExists[4] + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col);
				break;
			case 5:
				result = (-3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * (double)valueNotExists[4] + parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col);
				break;
			case 6:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col);
				break;
			case 7:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col) * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * parameterValue[4]);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
			{
				double num = parameterValue[0] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				_ = valueNotExists[0];
				_ = valueNotExists[2];
				result = num - 0.0;
				break;
			}
			case 2:
				result = parameterValue[1] - parameterValue[2] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			}
			return result;

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 10:
				result = parameterValue[6] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 0.5) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			case 11:
				result = parameterValue[7] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));

				break;

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 10:
				result = parameterValue[6] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 0.5) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			case 11:
				result = parameterValue[7] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 10:
				result = parameterValue[6] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 0.5) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			case 11:
				result = parameterValue[7] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)39, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)23, col) * (parameterValue[0] - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0)) + parameterValue[4] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 4.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 4.0)));
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)23, col) * (parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0))) + 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 4.0 * (parameterValue[4] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 4.0))));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)23, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) + 6.0 * (parameterValue[4] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 4.0))));
				break;
			case 7:

				break;
			case 8:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)23, col) * (parameterValue[4] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 4.0));

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 10:
				result = parameterValue[6] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 0.5) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col);
				break;
			case 11:
				result = parameterValue[7] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)23, col) * (parameterValue[0] - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0)));
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)23, col) * (parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0))) + 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)23, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))));
				break;
			case 6:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)23, col) * (parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0));
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)23, col) * (parameterValue[0] - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0)) + parameterValue[4] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 4.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 4.0)));
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)23, col) * (parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0))) + 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 4.0 * (parameterValue[4] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 4.0))));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)23, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) + 6.0 * (parameterValue[4] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 4.0))));
				break;

				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)23, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)23, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:

				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)23, col));
				break;

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)

				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)44, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 10:

				break;

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = parameterValue[0] - parameterValue[3] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + (parameterValue[5] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col))) * (double)(valueNotExists[3] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]));
				break;
			case 3:
				result = parameterValue[1] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			case 4:
				result = parameterValue[2] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) - UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * (double)(valueNotExists[3] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = parameterValue[4] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[5] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col))) * (double)(valueNotExists[3] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]));
				break;
			case 6:
				result = parameterValue[5] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0);
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[6] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), parameterValue[7]);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = parameterValue[0] - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) / Math.Log(10.0)) + (parameterValue[5] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col))) * (double)(valueNotExists[3] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]));
				break;
			case 3:
				result = parameterValue[1] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			case 4:
				result = parameterValue[2] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) - UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * (double)(valueNotExists[3] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = parameterValue[4] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[5] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col))) * (double)(valueNotExists[3] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]));
				break;
			case 6:
				result = parameterValue[5] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0);
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[6] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), parameterValue[7]);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

				break;
			case 4:
				result = parameterValue[2] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) - UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * (double)(valueNotExists[3] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]));
				break;

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = (parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0] + Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)26, col));
				break;
			case 3:
				result = (3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			case 5:
				result = parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7])));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			case 9:
				result = parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0);
				break;
			case 10:
				result = parameterValue[6] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 0.5);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

				break;
			case 2:
				result = parameterValue[1] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = parameterValue[2] - parameterValue[3] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * ((UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) - 1.0) * 273.15);
				break;
			case 4:
				result = parameterValue[3] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			case 5:
				result = parameterValue[5] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
