		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = parameterValue[0] - Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col)) - parameterValue[2] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * (double)(valueNotExists[1] * valueNotExists[2]);
				break;
			case 2:
				result = parameterValue[1] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = parameterValue[3] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = parameterValue[0] + Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col)) - parameterValue[4] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * valueNotExists[6]));
				break;
			case 3:
				result = parameterValue[1] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			case 4:
				result = parameterValue[2] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) - UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * valueNotExists[6]));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = parameterValue[3] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			case 6:
				result = parameterValue[5] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), parameterValue[6]);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = parameterValue[0] - parameterValue[1] * UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			case 2:
				result = parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		{

			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:

				break;
			case 2:
				result = parameterValue[1] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * parameterValue[2] - UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 10:
				result = parameterValue[6] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 0.5) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col);
				break;
			case 11:
				result = parameterValue[7] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)20, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)21, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)21, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)21, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)21, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)21, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)21, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 10:
				result = parameterValue[6] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 0.5) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)21, col);
				break;
			case 11:
				result = parameterValue[7] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)21, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 10:
				result = parameterValue[6] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 0.5) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col);
				break;
			case 11:
				result = parameterValue[7] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)41, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = parameterValue[0] * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col)) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			case 2:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col) * parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)115, col) * (parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 2:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)115, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 3:
				result = parameterValue[4] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override double ConvertElementWithFormula(int formulaIndex, int col, double[] parameterValue, int[] valueNotExists)
		{
			double result = 0.0;
			switch (formulaIndex)
			{
			case 1:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col) * ((parameterValue[2] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)) - parameterValue[1] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) - parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) - parameterValue[7] * Math.Log(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col)) + parameterValue[0]);
				break;
			case 3:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col) * ((3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) - 2.0 * (parameterValue[2] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0)))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))) + parameterValue[1] / UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col));
				break;
			case 5:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col) * (parameterValue[2] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0) - 3.0 * (parameterValue[3] * (UnitConvFactorB((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0))) * (double)(valueNotExists[4] * (valueNotExists[5] * (valueNotExists[6] * valueNotExists[7]))));
				break;
			case 7:
				result = parameterValue[3] / Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 3.0) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col);
				break;
			case 8:
				result = parameterValue[4] * (UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col));
				break;
			case 9:
				result = UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col) * (parameterValue[5] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 2.0));
				break;
			case 10:
				result = parameterValue[6] * Math.Pow(UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)22, col), 0.5) * UnitConvFactorA((PhysicalQuantities)43, col);
